provenance.launchedExplain: A launch record links this session to Olivares: it started this session. What can be done with it now is below — a launch is not the same as a live process.
provenance.discoveredExplain: No launch record links this session, so as far as this plane can prove, Olivares did not start it. It can be read and audited, not steered.
provenance.unknownExplain: Whether Olivares launched this session could not be checked — your role cannot read launched sessions, or the lookup failed. This is “not read”, not “not launched”.

control.title: What can be done with it
control.fullExplain: Olivares holds the process and bridges its I/O: it can be watched, driven and stopped.
control.lifecycleExplain: Start and stop, nothing in between: either Olivares holds the process but not its I/O, or the process is stopped and can be resumed.
control.observeExplain: Olivares holds no process for this session. It can be read and audited; stopping it is not something this plane can do.
control.unknownExplain: The operate half was not read (your role cannot read launched sessions), so this is what is visible from the observed half alone.

cap.watch: Watch its live telemetry and timeline
cap.attach: See its I/O as it happens

reason.no-run: no process: Olivares did not launch this session
reason.no-observation: nothing observed for this session yet
reason.transport: its I/O is relayed to Anthropic’s cloud, so Olivares cannot show or drive it
reason.state: not in a state that allows it
reason.permission: your role does not include it

actions.cleanupHint: Closes the run and releases its resume handle, so it can no longer be resumed. The lifecycle ledger is kept.
actions.deleteHint: Removes the session. It can no longer be continued; its lifecycle events stay in the audit log.

postureValue.enforced: Enforced — its tool calls are policed in line
postureValue.observed: Observed — its tool calls are recorded, not policed

card.unclaimed: Activity seen from a session holding no live claim. The engine reports it; it is not the same signal as a possible evasion.
card.relayedIO: Its I/O is relayed to Anthropic’s cloud, so Olivares cannot show it here. Lifecycle control still applies.
card.observedNotRead: The observed half was not read: your role cannot read observed sessions.
card.failureReasonMissing: This session failed. The server did not report a reason.
card.hostIsolationRemedy: Ask the server administrator to allow unprivileged user and network namespaces and Landlock, then start the session again.
card.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.
card.pickRun: Several runs drive this session. Pick one to attach, govern or stop it.

attributionExplain.legacy: Folded from a channel with no registered source: a legacy connector, a pushed collector observation or an old event. It is never assigned a provider instance after the fact.
attributionExplain.observed: Arrived through a source dedicated to this provider profile. That says which configured source delivered it — not that the id inside belongs to a process Olivares launched.
attributionExplain.source: Arrived through a registered source that is not dedicated to any profile: the channel is known, the provider instance is not.
attributionExplain.managed: Written by Olivares' own bridge for a session it launched: the only row that carries a proven canonical session and run.

related.title: Also observed through bound sources
related.explain: These rows share this run's profile and provider session id but arrived through a source, not through the process Olivares holds. They are shown beside the run, never merged into it.
